input.command:
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination && mkdir -p data/exp_llama8b_10k results/exp_llama8b_10k && nohup bash -c '
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
cd /root/autodl-tmp/gen-depth-contamination

echo "[Phase 1] LLaMA-8B generation start: $(date)"
python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B \
  --data_dir data/exp_llama8b_10k \
  --results_dir results/exp_llama8b_10k \
  --generation_mode continuation \
  --top_p 0.95 --temperature 1.0 \
  --seed 42 --num_samples 10000 --max_depth 5 --batch_size 8

echo "[Phase 1 done] $(date)"

rm -f data/exp_llama8b_10k/features.csv

echo "[Phase 2] Qwen scorer start: $(date)"
python3 scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/Qwen2___5-1___5B-Instruct \
  --data_dir data/exp_llama8b_10k \
  --results_dir results/exp_llama8b_10k \
  --skip_generation \
  --seed 42 --num_samples 10000 --max_depth 5

echo "[Phase 2 done] $(date)"
echo "ALL_DONE"
' > /tmp/exp_llama8b_10k.log 2>&1 &
echo "PID=$!"

    r = requests.get(url, stream=True, timeout=120)
    r.raise_for_status()
    with open(shard_path, 'wb') as f:

            f.write(chunk)
    print(f'Downloaded: {os.path.getsize(shard_path)} bytes')

data_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path = data_dir / 'depth_0.jsonl'

records = []
max_tokens = 256
num_samples = 10000

with gzip.open(shard_path, 'rt') as f:
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        if len(records) >= num_samples:
            break
        ex = json.loads(line)
        text = ex.get('text', '')
        ids = tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        if len(ids) < 32:

        trunc_ids = ids[:max_tokens]
        trunc_text = tok.decode(trunc_ids, skip_special_tokens=True)
        records.append({'text': trunc_text, 'doc_id': len(records)})

with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
    for r in records:
        f.write(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

print(f'Saved {len(records)} records to {out_path}')
